About me

I’m a final-year Electronics and Communication Engineering student at the College of Engineering Trivandrum, with a strong foundation in digital design, embedded systems, electronic circuit design and signal processing.

I’m passionate about semiconductor (VLSI) technologies, embedded systems and high-performance computing, and I like turning that into efficient, working hardware.

Alongside engineering, I lead multidisciplinary teams and manage technical events, sponsorships and budgets.

Projects

Intelligent Speed Sign Detection and Autonomous Speed Control

  • Raspberry Pi 4
  • TensorFlow Lite
  • MobileNetV2
  • L298N
+
  • Built a Raspberry Pi 4 Edge AI system for real-time traffic speed sign detection using TensorFlow Lite.
  • Optimized a MobileNetV2 CNN with Int8 quantization, reducing the model from 25 MB to 3.2 MB.
  • Integrated a USB camera, Raspberry Pi and L298N motor driver for autonomous PWM-based speed control.
  • Achieved 94.8% detection accuracy with 75 ms end-to-end latency.

Two-Stage Linux Bootloader (x86)

  • x86 Assembly
  • BIOS interrupts
  • Disk I/O
+
  • Designed a custom two-stage bootloader in x86 Assembly.
  • A 512-byte Stage 1 initializes the system and loads Stage 2 from disk.
  • Stage 2 configures the execution environment and transfers control to the Linux kernel.
  • Hands-on with BIOS interrupts, disk I/O, memory management and the Linux boot process.

Operating System Development (x86)

  • Interrupts
  • Scheduling

Ongoing

Developing a custom operating system kernel to understand memory management, interrupt handling, process scheduling and low-level system programming.
